calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-13-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patricia VanSteenberge
Petitioner: Cassidy Tai, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem the Minors: Lesi Huang and Xue Jin Huang, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Charles Zhang.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Declaration of Kin Wing Won, the minors father, consenting to the Name Change of the Minors filed 02-21-07 is in file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Celia Wong and Kevin Wong.
Decree signed in open court.
